_comment: The curated mod list for Night City Online. Cam and the devs decide what is on it;
the launcher installs and verifies against it so everyone is running the same game.
Published as a release asset, so the list can change without shipping a launcher.
nexusModId / nexusFileId  identify the exact file on Nexus. Not the newest file -
a specific one, so a mod updating upstream does not
silently change what everyone is running mid-session.
sha256                    what actually got installed is checked against this.
Version strings lie: mods get re-uploaded under the same
version, and a half-finished download is still a file.
installPath               relative to the Cyberpunk 2077 folder.
required                  required mods block Play. Optional ones do not - cosmetic
choices should never stop someone joining.
The six prerequisites are NOT here. They ship inside FullInstall.zip because they are
MIT licensed and redistributable. Nexus mods are not ours to redistribute, which is
the whole reason this list points at Nexus rather than hosting the files.
